Africa Unpacked: How the conflict is reshaping Africa’s policy outlook

Our Africa Unpacked sessions give our lead economists and senior political analysts the opportunity to engage with your team and provide our view on the most important economic and political themes affecting the continent.

In our latest sessions, we examine how African governments are using policy levers to navigate the intermittent resurgence in tensions in the Middle East. In the truncated presentation preview, we briefly discuss:

How monetary policy has changed direction in several countries.

Fiscal pressures stemming from the conflict.

The political fallout and broader geopolitical posturing.
